# RallyCasts

> RallyCasts is the premier live pickleball streaming network, bracket tracker, and community highlight platform.

## About
RallyCasts provides high-definition court-side broadcasting, real-time scoreboards, automated highlights, and tournament organization for the fastest-growing sport in North America.

## Key Features & Capabilities
- **Live Match Streaming**: 4K multicam court-side broadcasts from parks, clubs, and sanctioned tournament venues.
- **Real-Time Scoreboards**: Instant point-by-point tracking with live serving indicators, game scores, and match results.
- **Tournament Engine**: Full bracket management, pool play, elimination rounds, and schedule coordination.
- **Caster Network**: Certified local videographers and casters streaming club events and open play.
- **Video Studio & Clutch Clips**: Instant highlight clipping for ATPs, ernes, dink rallies, and championship points.
- **Player & Venue Directory**: Comprehensive profiles for players, organizers, hosts, and verified pickleball facilities.

## Primary Routes
- Homepage: https://rallycasts.tv
- Events & Tournaments: https://rallycasts.tv/events
- Videos & Clips: https://rallycasts.tv/videos
- Trending Matches: https://rallycasts.tv/trending
- Casters Network: https://rallycasts.tv/casters
- Players: https://rallycasts.tv/players
- Venues: https://rallycasts.tv/venues
